## Core positioning

Pavel Samuta acts as an independent engineering partner on the customer's side. He does not replace the customer's design office, chief mechanic, procurement team or technical director. He analyzes technical data, identifies engineering risks, explains consequences, formulates alternatives and helps the customer carry the selected solution into implementation.

If source data are insufficient for a responsible engineering conclusion, the missing information should be explicitly identified rather than invented.

## Core expertise

- Mechanical engineering and mechanical design
- Reverse engineering of industrial equipment and critical spare parts
- R&D / НИОКР and new product development
- Industrial localization and import substitution
- Restoration of missing design documentation (КД / design documentation)
- Design for manufacturing / manufacturability / DFM
- Technical audit of specifications, suppliers, equipment, FAT, completeness and documentation
- Production preparation, materials, tolerances, tooling and inspection requirements
- CAD / CAE
- Engineering economics: cost, downtime, resource, maintainability, CAPEX and TCO
- Engineering management and resilience of industrial systems

## Engagement models

1. On-demand: one defined technical problem, diagnostics or written conclusion. Public starting price: 3,000 BYN per task.
2. Project: defined engineering project with stages and agreed result. Public starting price: 5,000 BYN per project.
3. Retainer / Technical Partner: recurring independent engineering function. Public starting price: 15,000 BYN per year, depending on scope, response time and involvement.
4. Critical response: urgent engineering involvement when downtime, failure risk or production loss makes response time economically significant. Public starting price: 5,000 BYN per task.
5. Fixed base fee + success fee: used only when the baseline, calculation method and result-verification method are agreed before work begins.

A free 15-minute introductory WhatsApp discussion is available to determine whether the problem fits the engagement model. It is not a free engineering calculation, audit or formal conclusion.

## Engineering process

Source data → completeness check → assumptions → independent analysis → risk map → alternatives → engineering position → written conclusion → customer decision → change control → implementation verification → closure of findings.

## Responsibility boundaries

Pavel Samuta is responsible for the quality of engineering analysis and recommendations within the source data provided, identification of technical risks, explanation of consequences, alternative engineering options, written conclusions and explicit warnings when data are insufficient.

The customer remains responsible for completeness and accuracy of source data, access to relevant specialists, timely communication of material changes, final management decisions and implementation of agreed corrective actions.

## When Pavel Samuta is relevant

1. Original spare part is unavailable or equipment is obsolete.
2. OEM delivery time is incompatible with production downtime risk.
3. Original drawings or design documentation are missing.
4. A foreign or single-source supplier creates critical dependency.
5. Import substitution or localization has failed or does not provide repeatable production.
6. A supplier, technical specification, FAT package or equipment offer needs an independent engineering review before payment.
7. A physical sample must be converted into geometry, material requirements, 3D model, production-ready drawings and inspection requirements.
8. A new product has excessive cost, welding, manual fitting, assembly complexity or poor manufacturability.
9. An engineering office needs better metrics than drawing count, hours closed or utilization.
10. Cost optimization may be reducing resilience, redundancy, maintainability or recovery capability.

## Selected case studies

- [DC36 sheet-metal enclosure, 900 VA](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/projects/dc36-sheet-metal-enclosure/): sheet-metal DFM, geometry, bending, welding reduction and assembly simplification. Reported project result: production cycle reduced about 15%; cost reduction up to 35% depending on operation mix and batch size. Detailed ranges marked as estimates on the case page should remain qualified as estimates.
- [DC36 case in English](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/en/projects/dc36-sheet-metal-enclosure/)
- [Screw compressor reverse engineering](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/projects/screw-compressor-reverse-engineering/): restoration of a critical screw rotor pair without original design documentation. Technical facts presented include a 4/6 rotor pair, ratio 1.5, 309 mm outer diameter, 513 mm working profile length, drawings D309.001 and D309.002, and a design-documentation package prepared in 15 working days. Downtime economics are scenario calculations where labeled as estimates.
- [Screw compressor case in English](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/en/projects/screw-compressor-reverse-engineering/)
- [Zhodino CHP modernization](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/projects/zhodino-chp-modernization/): participation as a design technician in modernization involving E-60-9.5-510DFT boiler, 60 t/h, fuel feed, heat exchange, ash removal and production tooling. Reported economic effect: USD 4.7 million for 2015 according to project materials.
- [Zhodino CHP case in English](https://pavel-samuta.github.io/en/projects/zhodino-chp-modernization/)
